method: Manual shape-class optical review, not centroid or equal filled area

items.Network: Outer ring and equator 28→32, meridian 26→30 native units. Fullness increases without changing the globe envelope or adding fine grids.
items.Signal_Light: Pill height 104→116, y128→122, radius52→58; width and three 44-unit holes stay fixed. Adds 6 units of white above/below holes, avoiding a skinny horizontal capsule at 36px.
items.Stream: Enclosing ring 28→32 only. Play triangle and generous negative clearance retained; no blind enlargement.
items.Tick: Open check stroke34→38. Adds perceived weight to this sparse subject without scaling its span or disturbing the rounded join.
items.Transfer: Arrow strokes30→32; top shaft y127→133 and bottom y233→227, including both arrowheads. Pair is 12 units more compact vertically while retaining a 27-unit arrowhead-to-opposite-shaft gap and a 62-unit shaft gap.
items.Tick_2: Retained. Existing 28-unit ring/check balance leaves roughly20-unit critical inner clearance; thickening would sacrifice that clearance for little gain.
items.Flight: Retained. Already cohesive broad rocket with one42-unit window. Separate flame clearance was explicitly repaired in V2 and remains readable; moving it inward risks fusion at36px.
items.ASIA: Retained. Existing land/rim union is a single cohesive generalized silhouette; additional thickening would close ocean features.
items.Global: Retained. Existing land/rim union is a single cohesive generalized silhouette, with broad ocean cutout; no fine islands or grids.
items.Network_2: Retained. Existing Americas/rim union has two generous ocean cutouts; do not compress these or equalize geographic mass by blind scaling.
items.Dolphin: Retained: the existing 0.94 optical fit already compacts the diagonal arch/tail without weakening its 24.44-unit effective eye. Do not normalize its long silhouette to the panda head bounding box.
items.Fish: Translate down 5 native units only: the dorsal fin makes the compact oval sit high against the accepted Pig. No scaling, so the 26-unit eye and generous tail/body junction remain intact.
items.Fish_b: Retained: tall sail-tail plus lower fin already balance vertically; its pointed outline intentionally differs from the compact Fish.
items.Globefish: Retained: one connected plump body, sparse large spines and balanced side fins. Its 188-unit core avoids an oversized head; 26-unit eyes and 24x30-unit mouth remain unchanged.
items.Panda: Retained relative to Pig: 222-unit head width versus Pig 222, with rounded ears integrated into the contour. Broad eye patches, 24-unit pupils and 20-unit meaningful surrounding gaps remain intact.
items.Panda_ai: Compact only the external leaf crest: keep its base connection unchanged but lower the high leaf tips by 9 native units (roughly 0.9px at default body36). The face, ears, eye patches and 24-unit pupils are untouched; less detached-looking top accent, same nature identity.
items.Yin_Yang: Retained: circular 242-unit outer diameter intentionally compensates the half-negative interior. Scaling to a filled animal head would make the 26-unit ring and 30-unit dots unnecessarily weak.
items.AI_Tree: Refine: terminal radius 22→24; spoke length 96→86 and width 24→26. Overall diameter 236→220; stronger hub cohesion. Central 24-unit hole and 22-unit white ring preserved. No global scale.
items.AI_voice: Refine: five 28-wide bars retained; gaps 22→20; total width 228→220. Heights 54/108/164/108/54→52/100/156/100/52. Compact rhythm without shrinking width or losing minimum gaps.
items.SNS: Refine: side centers 84/276→90/270; side widths 64→60, central width 84→76. Overall width 256→240. Body gaps stay 22; head-to-body gaps 24/25 retained; optical upward 7 retained.
items.Other: Refine: dot centers 92/180/268→100/180/260; diameter 54 unchanged. Gaps 34→26; total width 230→214. Intentional wide/short ellipsis optical exception: no giant dots or enclosure.
items.AI: Retain: connected head, ear and antenna mass is already cohesive; eye openings 28×44 remain robust.
items.AI_bot: Retain: one rounded speech mass, 28×46 eyes; existing optical downward 5.
items.Adblock: Retain: single compact shield, generous 100×28 negative minus.
items.Consistent_Hashing: Retain: cohesive stopwatch ring/crown, 32 stroke; separated hand is essential and spacious.
items.DIRECT: Retain: input node merges into arrow shaft; intentional horizontal optical exception.
items.Failover: Retain: U-route is connected; cross is meaningful failure indicator, not decorative scatter.
items.Forbidden: Retain: balanced continuous ring and diagonal, 32 width.
items.GFW: Retain: regular 2×3 wall blocks already have only 20/24-unit gaps; further packing would compromise negative spaces. Arrow is essential directional modifier.
items.Home: Retain: substantial connected silhouette with 48-wide open doorway.
items.Location: Retain: single pin mass with 68-diameter opening; no packing needed.
items.Magic_Timer: Retain: compact crown/ring, interior lightning remains separated to preserve legibility.
items.Mail: Retain: single envelope mass, broad 24-wide negative chevron.
items.Remote: Retain: four directional heads form one tight symmetric cluster with purposeful central negative space.
items.Round_Robin: Retain: continuous circular route and substantial head, existing optical left 6.

independent_review: No genuine scale/scatter blocker; DIRECT/Other naturally low-profile; AI_voice/SNS readable and balanced. All actual36px cutouts remain open.
